notes.title: Mokoko X and all other NAISU games have +50% discount now!
notes.notes: Our games have 50% or more discounts for the next 2 weeks!

notes.title: Discount opportunities before the price increase
notes.notes:
Until the new year, there will be various discount events with the current prices. But starting with 2023, we are going to edit all our games' prices according to the Steam's recommended pricing conversion.

The base prices of the games in USD are not going to be changed. For example, Mokoko X will stay the same as $9.99. But the other currencies will be effected. Most of the currencies will have some price increases.

The exact date is not yet decided it will happen in the new year for sure. We wanted to notify you before the prices change.

notes.title: Trading cards and other community items released!
notes.notes: Trading cards, emoticons, backgrounds and badges have been released!

notes.title: Trading cards very soon! Achievements are valid.
notes.notes:
Hello!

Mokoko X passed "Steam is learning more about this game" status and qualified for achievement validation and trading card drops. 

The trading cards are going to be enabled as soon as Steam review is completed in a few days.

notes.title: Update notes for May 25
notes.notes:
- Korean translation improved
- Minor bug fixes
- Videos not appearing for Mac M1 fixed.

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Hello,

We have prepared badges, trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons. You can see in our store page that "Steam is learning about this game" text is written. Once this text is removed, trading cards and other community items are going to be enabled. But more reviews are needed to achieve this. The exact number is hidden and there are more factors to this, but from my experience I am guessing that we will need at least 80 reviews.

[b]If you want trading cards sooner, please write a review for Mokoko X to help us publish them. [/b]

notes.title: Mokoko X has been released!
notes.notes:
The great day has come! I hope everything goes well and you enjoy the game! There is going to be a one week discount for Mokoko X and all other NAISU games.

The game is well polished, but if you encounter any bugs or game breaking issues, feel free to write us from Steam discussions. I will be watching like an hawk for any issues! Immediate action will be taken.

notes.title: Tomorrow is the big day!
notes.notes:
The release day of Mokoko X has exactly 24 hours remaining by the time this announcement is made. As you can guess, we are very excited!!!

There will be a first week discount for Mokoko X. For honoring Mokoko X all the other NAISU games are going to have big discounts as well.

It has been a long journey for us, we've tried our best to revive the dead arcade genre of Qix, Volfied and Gals Panic kind of games with a modern touch. We hope you will like Mokoko X. Feel free to review the game and share your opinions in Steam discussions. 

NAISU
